nav.motto: A brighter future begins with you.

public.footer: © Gifted — discover, explore, and develop your potential.

landing.intro: Gifted helps young people discover, test and grow their potential — through short assessments, real-world missions and a Passport that evolves with them.

discover.title: Discover
discover.text: A short assessment surfaces your first interests and signals.

explore.title: Explore
explore.text: Real-world missions test those signals through action.

grow.title: Grow
grow.text: Every activity adds evidence — never a fixed label.

passport.title: Gifted Passport
passport.text: Your journey. Your story. Your evidence.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue your journey with Gifted.
login.error: That email and password don't match. Please try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Begin your Gifted journey.
register.error: Could not create the account. Try a different email or a stronger password.

dashboard.welcomeStarted: You're {{progress}}% through your Discovery assessment — pick up right where you left off.
dashboard.welcomeNew: Today's a great day to take your first step. This session helps you discover what you enjoy and how you think.
dashboard.pickUp: Pick up where you left off.
dashboard.beginWith: Begin with ten short moments about what you enjoy.

assessmentCard.title: Discovery Assessment
assessmentCard.text: Activities, situations, two quick puzzles and what you've tried so far.

passportCard.title: Your Gifted Passport
passportCard.text: Opens with your first signals after the assessment.

session.title: Your Session Today
session.subtitle: A few steps toward your first Passport.

passport.title: Open your Passport
passport.text: See your first signals come together.

dashboard.growing: Your Passport is growing — new evidence has been added.
dashboard.profileReady: Your emerging profile is ready. Continue your journey.
dashboard.builtFromWithMissions_one: Built from {{responses}} assessment responses and {{count}} exploration mission.
dashboard.builtFromWithMissions_other: Built from {{responses}} assessment responses and {{count}} exploration missions.

profile.title: Your emerging profile
profile.text: Your first interests, how you think and what you've tried — from your Discovery assessment.

next.missionText: {{title}} — a short hands-on challenge that adds new evidence to your Passport.
next.grewText: Your mission evidence now sits beside your assessment signals. More missions are coming soon.

missions.title: Exploration missions
missions.intro: Short real-world challenges that help you test your emerging signals through action. Every mission adds evidence to your Passport — never a score.
missions.more: More missions and virtual labs are on the way. Each one will explore a different direction, so your Passport can draw on more than one kind of evidence.

page.error: We couldn't open your Passport right now.
page.intro: A living record of your interests, evidence and growth — built from what you’ve explored so far.
page.currentSignalsNote: From your assessment answers — the insight below explains them, it never changes them.
page.explorationEvidenceNote: Recorded from what you did in missions. It sits beside your assessment signals — it doesn't change them.
page.suggestsNote: An interpretation of the signals above. It explains them — it never changes them.
page.notCovered: This interpretation was written from your assessment. Your mission evidence is shown above and will be included the next time your interpretation is refreshed.
page.cantTell: What the evidence can’t tell yet
page.worthExploringNote: Open questions your next experiences can answer.

empty.title: Your Gifted Passport starts with discovery.
empty.text: Complete the Discovery assessment — about 5 minutes — and your Passport will open with your first signals.

signals.title: Current signals
signals.text: Your interest signals, scored from your own answers.

strengths.title: Emerging strengths
strengths.text: What your evidence suggests so far — never a fixed label.

next.title: Next exploration
next.text: One concrete thing to try, chosen from your signals.

journey.two: Discover and Explore are under way. Validate opens as more varied evidence — more missions and real experiences — builds up.
journey.one: Discover is complete. Explore opens with your first mission — see your next exploration below.
journey.none: Your journey begins with the Discovery assessment.

evidence.title: Evidence so far
evidence.includes: Your profile now includes evidence from {{assessments}} and {{missions}}.
evidence.early: Your Passport is still early — every new activity adds evidence.

log.title: Evidence log
log.exploredNote: What your activities gave evidence of.
log.singlePoint: One activity is a single data point — it adds context, not a verdict.

next.aiNote: Suggested with AI from your current signals.
next.general: A general exploration that adds a different kind of evidence — not tailored to the suggestion on the left.

assessment.unavailable: This assessment isn't available right now.
assessment.tryLater: Please try again in a moment.
assessment.title: What you enjoy, how you think
assessment.intro: Ten short moments — activities, situations, a couple of quick puzzles. About 5 minutes.
assessment.puzzleNote: Just a quick puzzle — one small piece of evidence, never a verdict.
assessment.noRightAnswers: There are no right or wrong answers — choose what feels most true right now.

completed.title: You've completed this assessment
completed.text: Your answers are already part of your emerging profile and Gifted Passport.
completed.retakeQuestion: Want to see how your answers change?

confidence.LOW: An early signal — more exploration will help clarify this.
confidence.HIGH: A strong, consistent signal across your answers.

result.exposureNote: These are early signals from your assessments. Real-world exploration will help confirm and refine them.

empty.title: No signals yet.
empty.text: Complete an assessment to see your emerging profile.

result.title: Your emerging profile
result.intro: Here's a summary of what we've learned from your assessment so far. This reflects early signals, not fixed conclusions — it will keep evolving as you explore.
result.offlineOne: Your current responses show stronger interest in {{a}}. This is an emerging signal, not a fixed label.
result.offlineTwo: Your current responses show stronger interest in {{a}} and {{b}}. This is an emerging signal, not a fixed label.
result.currentInterestsNote: Assessment signals from your answers — they stay the same whatever the insight says.
result.beyondNote: Reasoning, work style, values and experience — kept separate on purpose.
result.moreExploration: More real-world exploration can help clarify and grow these signals over time.

loading.patterns: Looking for patterns in your current evidence…

badge.aiTitle: Written with AI from your assessment signals — it explains them and never changes them.

insight.exploreFurtherNote: Areas where there isn't enough evidence yet.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.note: From one or two quick puzzles — early evidence, not a measure of ability.

style.title: Work style
style.note_you: How you tend to approach things, from the situations in the assessment.
style.note_they: How they tend to approach things, from the situations in the assessment.

values.title: What matters
values.note: From the trade-off questions — neither side is better.

exposure.title: Experience so far
exposure.note: What has been tried — experience, not skill. Untried areas are open doors.

mission.unavailable: This mission isn't available right now.
mission.noRightAnswers: There are no right or wrong answers. Your choices add evidence to your Passport — they are not a test score.
mission.saveError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
mission.saved: Your progress is saved as you go.

done.title: New evidence added to your Gifted Passport.
done.text: This doesn't prove what you're good at — it adds one more piece of evidence about what you explored and how you made decisions. Your Passport becomes more informed, not final.
done.recorded: Recorded from the choices you made in this mission.

steps.left_one: {{count}} point left — you don't have to spend them all.
steps.left_other: {{count}} points left — you don't have to spend them all.
steps.notEnough: Not enough points left — swap something out.

picture.title: Current picture
picture.note: Interest signals from the Discovery assessment — not ability or career labels.

evidence.varied: Evidence now comes from more than one kind of activity.
evidence.oneAssessment: So far, the picture rests on one assessment.

parent.preparing: Preparing guidance from your child's current evidence…

next.note: A small activity to test a signal through real experience — not a commitment or a career choice.

notStarted.title: Discovery hasn't started yet.
notStarted.text: {{name}} hasn't completed the Discovery assessment, so there isn't enough evidence to describe anything yet — and we won't guess. Once they begin, you'll see:

later.signals: Their strongest current interest signals, and how much evidence supports them.
later.explored: What they have explored — and where exposure is still limited.
later.ideas: Calm, practical ideas for supporting them at home.

dashboard.title: Understand their journey, not just their scores.
dashboard.intro: A calm view of what {{name}} is exploring, how much evidence there is, and how you can support them.
dashboard.introEmpty: {{name}}'s Gifted Passport will appear here once they start discovering.

journeyNote.EMERGING: Discover is complete. The next stage begins when they try a hands-on mission.
journeyNote.GROWING: They've moved from discovering to exploring. Validate opens as more varied evidence builds up.

states.error: We couldn't load this page right now.
states.noChildText: Ask your child for their Gifted connection code (it looks like GFT-48291) to see their growth signals here.

insights.title: {{name}}'s current picture, explained
insights.intro: What we're seeing, the evidence behind it, what's still uncertain — and how to help without deciding too early.
insights.aiNote: AI-assisted: written from the signals and activities below. It explains them — it never scores your child.
insights.signalNote: Written from the signals and activities below.
insights.scoreNote: A score is the share of chances where your child picked that interest. Mission evidence is recorded separately and never changes these numbers.
insights.noActivities: No hands-on activities yet — so far the picture comes only from the assessment. A first mission will add evidence from real choices.
insights.beyondNote: Early reasoning, work style, values and experience — kept separate from interests.

companion.intro: A space to think out loud, ask anything and turn ideas into small next steps.
companion.panelSubtitle: Your thinking partner on the Gifted journey.
companion.welcome: Hi {{name}}! I’m your Gifted Companion. Ask me about a tricky topic, reflect on something you tried, or plan a small next step — I’ll use your Gifted progress to keep things relevant.
companion.placeholder: Tell me what’s on your mind…
companion.error: I couldn’t respond just now. Try again in a moment.
companion.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
companion.aiNote: The Companion can make mistakes. It helps you think — the decisions are yours.

about.title: About you
about.subtitle: What I use to personalise support — only your Gifted progress.
about.empty: Once you complete the Discovery Assessment, I can tailor my support to your interests.
about.unknown: I don’t know your age, grade or goals — share them only if you want to.

prompts.title: Suggested prompts
prompts.subtitle: Not sure what to talk about? Try one of these:
prompts.getting_started: What can I discover with Gifted?
prompts.unsure_interests: I’m not sure what I’m interested in yet
prompts.difficult_topic: Help me understand a difficult topic
prompts.weekly_plan: Help me make a small plan for this week
prompts.interest_meaning: What could my interest in {{interest}} mean?
prompts.current_interests: Help me understand what my current interests mean
prompts.skills_to_build: What skills could I try building?
prompts.reflect_mission: Help me reflect on my mission “{{mission}}”

diary.title: Diary moments
diary.text: Soon you’ll be able to save meaningful moments from your chats to My Diary — only when you choose to.

privacy.title: Private to you
privacy.text: Your conversations with your AI Companion are private and are not shown to parents.
